title: Length of the tableau source list
statement: For every finite-state Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input alphabet and all $n,t\in\mathbb{N}$, the source list for time $t$ has length equal to the tableau arity $B+3+k(B+1)+1$, where $B$ is the number of bits in a snapshot and $k$ is the number of work tapes.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
